name: FXML
about: FX Multitech Limited engages in the distribution and export of a diverse portfolio of products in India. The company primarily caters to the heating, ventilation, and air conditioning and industrial refrigeration industry. Its products include compressors, refrigeration & air-conditioning controls, industrial refrigeration controls, variable frequency drives and automation, specialized components & tools, heat exchangers, cold room evaporators, refrigerants and ancillary products. It serves the heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) and refrigeration industries across India through the distribution and export. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
